== Date-source audit (18 November 2026) ==
The old Released 24 September 2014 value cited only the parent set’s launch. No exact2014 own-face source was established in this audit. The complete actual Original image byte-matches the publisher’s 8 July 2018 public source record, so Released now states that proved bound rather than borrowing the set day. Retired means numeric GEMP slot reuse, independently checked in complete before/after PC card data and native dated patch. The publisher’s native patch author-local date is 29 December 2024−0500; the UTC date is 30December. The publisher-local 29December is retained and is not replaced by a set legal date.
